name: Cold Open Evidence Hook vs Slow Atmospheric Intro
hypothesis: Starting directly with an impossible forensic anomaly in the first 2 seconds yields >25% higher 30-second retention than a slow atmospheric scene intro.

name: Haunting Cliffhanger Question vs Theory Summary
hypothesis: Ending on an unresolved, haunting question ('What do you think happened?') drives 3x higher comment-to-view engagement than summarizing theories.
